deadline.value: The priority deadline for Fall admission is February 15, and early applications are encouraged.
deadline.quote: The priority deadline for applications is February 15 for fall semester admission

supervisor.value: Applicants must secure an advisor before they are admitted.
supervisor.quote: Students must also secure an advisor prior to being admitted into the program

funding.value: Admitted students are generally awarded two years of assistantship funding covering the stipend, in-state tuition and insurance.
funding.quote: Students who are admitted are generally awarded two years of research and/or teaching assistantship funding upon entry

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree, or a master's degree, with a GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have previously obtained a bachelor’s degree or successfully completed a master’s degree

gre_subject.value: The ICS admissions page does not mention a GRE.

notes: Holistic review of GPA, writing samples, letters and a statement of purpose. Applicants must also meet Graduate School requirements, so fee and English rules come from the university record. Mapped to the environment field, though the program also draws on earth and social sciences.
name: PhD in Integrated Coastal Sciences
